Create a handle for a Grist document

Source: R/doc.R
grist_doc.Rd

grist_doc() creates a lightweight handle that identifies a Grist document and the server it lives on. The handle is passed as the first argument to most gristmillr functions so it works in pipelines:

grist_doc("<doc id>") |>
  grist_records("People")

Usage

grist_doc(doc, server = NULL, options = NULL, api_key = NULL)

Arguments

doc

A document ID, the URL of a document, or an existing grist_doc object.

server

URL of the Grist server, such as "https://docs.getgrist.com" or "https://myteam.getgrist.com". For a self-hosted server, include the team path if needed, e.g. "http://localhost:8484/o/docs". Defaults to the server in doc if doc is a URL, then the GRIST_SERVER environment variable, then "https://docs.getgrist.com".

options

A grist_request_options() object. If NULL, the default from getOption("gristmillr.request_options") or grist_request_options() is used.

api_key

A Grist API key, as a string or a function that returns one. Overrides any key in options. See the Authentication section.

Value

A grist_doc object with properties doc_id, server and options.

Authentication

Requests are authenticated with a Grist API key, found in this order:

  1. The api_key argument of grist_doc() or grist_request_options(), either a string or a function with no arguments that returns one.

  2. The GRIST_API_KEY environment variable.

A key supplied as a string is held in memory for the current session only, not stored in the object, so saving a handle with saveRDS() (or as a targets target) never writes the key to disk. A handle read back in a new session errors until you supply the key again. To make a handle that works across sessions, pass a function such as api_key = \() keyring::key_get("grist") or \() Sys.getenv("MY_KEY"). To keep a key encrypted on disk yourself, see httr2::secret_write_rds().

Avoid typing keys into scripts you share or commit.

See also

Other docs: grist_doc_create(), grist_doc_download(), grist_doc_import(), grist_request()

Examples

grist_doc("am2iHJ9Amvo7Ve3EE5emtu")
#> <grist_doc> "am2iHJ9Amvo7Ve3EE5emtu"
#> Server: <https://docs.getgrist.com>
grist_doc("https://docs.getgrist.com/doc/am2iHJ9Amvo7Ve3EE5emtu")
#> <grist_doc> "am2iHJ9Amvo7Ve3EE5emtu"
#> Server: <https://docs.getgrist.com>
